cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.

mechanism: A treats private approval as defective documentation and directs B toward an attributable public endorsement that shields the rota decision.
confusable: D55 recruits a coalition; D52 requires visible endorsement of a specific decision as protection against challenge.
comparison: Extension alternative negotiates identification on a signature; rota alternative converts spoken approval into distributed evidence.
seedUse: Rota, microphone, private assent and email copy derive from D52-a; S03 adds documentation and recipient corrections.
